criteria.rationale: R1 is verified by the failing pre-fix guard and passing restored guard; R2 by the cli test and audit of cmd/pose, cli, bootstrap and mcpserver initialization; R3 by the real pre-synced Harness build, vet, suite and parity self-test. Embedders using unknown do not distinguish revisions from each other; that is outside the binary version guarantee.
Version writes occur during package initialization before main and before runtime Store binding calls. No concurrent mutation or new goroutine is introduced; the complete module suite and vet passed.
Assessment binding fields and version.Version for the shipped binary are preserved. No REST, MCP, file or event schema changes occur; the assessment freshness integration and full suite pass.
Only the version source changes in CurrentAssessmentBinding. Git failure, dirty-tree, absent matrix and stale-reason paths retain their existing behavior and pass the module tests.

The engine no longer imports its sibling internal/version. Existing CLI and MCP initialization supply the same binary identity. Independently built and vetted the synchronized Harne8 Harness, passed its tests and parity self-test including 98 overlaid upstream test files.
Freshness states and engine-changed reasons remain unchanged for the binary; no new logs, sensitive values or error suppression are introduced.

CLI and MCP retain version.Version in bindings through initialization; JSON shape and output contracts are unchanged. Copying production files builds in Harness without import rewriting. The explicit unknown fallback is limited to external embedders.

Independently reverted only assessment_freshness.go to origin/main: the guard failed on the forbidden internal/version import with exit 1. Restored original bytes and observed pass. go vet and go test ./... -count=1 pass; production and tests remain unmodified.

D1 directly addresses R1 and R2: remove the one sibling import and inject binary identity at startup, preserving the byte-for-byte consumer contract. The actual sole cmd/pose entrypoint imports cli; bootstrap imports mcpserver. Both initializers run before runtime bindings. The declared falsifier was explicitly searched and not observed.

The spec records the package boundary, binary version guarantee, mirror rehearsal and D1 trade-off. Read the startup comments against actual init order. The unknown fallback must be understood as a shared identity for unset embedders, not proof that every stored binding is stale; the independent review and final residual-risk report state this limit.

Existing engine-changed diagnostics and binding schema remain intact. The guard identifies the offending filename and import. No migration or new runtime dependency is required; embedders can set EngineVersion at startup.

R1 has a demonstrated negative control and positive guard. R2 has TestBinaryRecordsItsVersionInAssessmentBindings plus production entrypoint audit. R3 passed independently in the prepared cirepro Harness and parity self-test. Full native validation is 133/133 pass at the reviewed HEAD.

Bugfix scope matches all seven declared artifact paths and observed Git attribution. Rules applied: backend-go for initialization and tests, security for identity and secrets, documentation-style for spec, delivery-evidence and delivery-surface for capability composition. Frontend, infrastructure and knowledge rules are inapplicable. Reviewer is a maintainer-authorized Codex/OpenAI execution distinct from implementer Claude/Anthropic session 296d1fcb-e989-40ae-9362-cf3514db8b26 agent:claude-opus-5-5. The agent:independent- prefix is an engine-required declaration until pose-delegated-review-run-provenance replaces it. Identity is declared and attestations here are unsigned; cognitive independence is not mechanically proven.

No dependency, authentication, authorization, network or policy change. Reviewed the diff for secret exposure and ran a bounded secret-pattern scan with no matches. No dynamic input is added; Go internal boundaries are restored for mirror consumers. Dedicated gitleaks and govulncheck binaries are unavailable and no scanner success is claimed.

D1 is smaller for the stated consumer contract than mirroring another internal package and rewriting imports. No generalized provider interface or extra dependency is introduced. Unknown-to-unknown revision ambiguity is a documented external-embedder consequence. A binary binding that records unknown would invalidate D1; auditing the current production entrypoint and tests found none.
